newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish grain board still assessing barley tender.
newsitem.headline: Turkish grain board still assessing barley tender.

text.p: Turkey's state grain board (TMO) is still assessing bids at a tender to sell 100,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley, TMO officials said on Tuesday.
They said the result might be announced before midday on Wednesday.
Seven international companies -- Cargill, Finagrain, Louis Dreyfus, Lacosp, Alfred Toepfer, Glencore and Grains & Fourrages -- presented bids on Tuesday for the tender.
Prices for feed barley ranged between $134.27 and $142.56 per tonne. Only Toepfer had bid for malting barley, at $143.62 per tonne.
